title: Routing requests
description:
Send each request to the right handler and complete it exactly once.

```
IRP_MJ_CREATE -> ok
IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL IOCTL_ECHO -> echoed 5 bytes
IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL unknown code -> STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_REQUEST
IRP_MJ_READ (not supported) -> STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_REQUEST
```
hints: Fill the whole table with the default first, then set the ones you support (lesson 16.03).
Every path through a handler must end in exactly one completion.
requirements: A table of handlers by major function, all defaulting to a "not supported" handler.
The device control handler switches on the IOCTL code.
A `complete` function refuses to complete the same request twice.
